## What changed?

Describe the resulting behavior.

## Why?

Link the related GitHub issue/user story and explain the problem. For a sub-task, link the parent feature and identify remaining integration dependencies.

## How was it tested?

List automated checks and manual tests with results. State blocked or unperformed checks and acceptance criteria that remain outstanding.

## Migrations, configuration, and dependencies

Describe required setup steps, migrations, new dependencies, and compatibility changes, or state that none are required.

## Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria relevant to this PR have been addressed.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated, or the reason they are unnecessary is documented.
- [ ] Applicable local lint, test, build, system, and migration checks pass.
- [ ] Database migrations are included when required.
- [ ] No secrets or local configuration files are committed.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and safe environment templates are updated.
- [ ] Remaining integration work and dependencies are identified.
- [ ] Ready for code review.

Required CI and review are merge gates. Parent story completion also requires integrated acceptance testing and PO acceptance; see [Feature Quality and Product Acceptance](../docs/Quality.md).
